skillsViewer.title: Skills Viewer

skillsViewer.unsupported: Skills Viewer requires desktop Electron environment, not available in current environment
skillsViewer.noSkillsAllTools: No Skills files found for any AI tool
skillsViewer.noSkillsForTool: No Skills files found for this tool
skillsViewer.noSourcesEnabled: No load sources selected. Enable at least one path in Load Sources
skillsViewer.pathHint: Skills are typically stored in ~/.claude/skills/ or .claude/skills/ in project directory
skillsViewer.projectPathPlaceholder: Enter project root directory path for scanning project-level Skills
skillsViewer.skillNameInvalid: frontmatter.name violates the spec (lowercase kebab-case, ≤64 chars)
skillsViewer.skillNameMismatch: frontmatter.name does not match the folder name (spec requires they match)
skillsViewer.editSkillHint: Click save button after editing to write to file
skillsViewer.saveSkillFrontmatterRequired: Save blocked: YAML frontmatter (name/description) was removed, the skill would not be recognized
skillsViewer.deleteSkillConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this Skill? This action cannot be undone.
skillsViewer.copySkillConfirm: Select target AI coding tool to copy the current Skill to its skills directory
skillsViewer.copySkillFailed: Copy failed (target already exists or permission denied)
